title: Spindel
lead: '''Spindel''' is a weaker variant of [[Venenatis]] who is fought in the [[Web Chasm]], a [[singles-plus combat]] area in level 29 [[Wilderness]]. To enter Spindel's lair, players must have completed the [[Wilderness Diary#Hard|hard Wilderness diary]], '''OR''' they must have a Venenatis boss Slayer task (a spider Slayer task does not bypass the diary requirement).
